objectives.description: Regenerate this repo's deployed tree from source
FRESH direction: gate-in against a real non-terminal task, no warning
STALE direction: scratch clone, rewritten source_git_head, gate-in shows WARN
Measure and record added preflight wall time
Record both captured outputs verbatim in the summary with root cause

verification_notes: deploy-headless.sh (default, non-destructive mode) resynced 6 extensions in 1.834s real time; .claude-extensions.json afterward carries a distinct 40-hex source_git_head for every extension (email, core, memory, nvim, literature, nix).
FRESH: sourced gate_in against task 20 (not_started) in this repo post-deploy -- output was exactly '[IMPLEMENT] Task 20: fix_todo_metrics_sync_precommit_phantom_paths', no WARN line, return code 0.

STALE: built a scratch target repo via mktemp -d, deployed core into it (1 extension bootstrapped), then rewrote .claude-extensions.json's core.source_git_head to an older real commit (10 commits back from HEAD) via jq. Re-sourcing gate_in there (task 20, copied specs/state.json) produced the header line plus a 3-line WARN naming 'core' and both remedies (deploy-headless.sh, verify-deploy.sh --findings), return code still 0. Scratch dir removed afterward; this repo's own .claude-extensions.json/HEAD were never touched by the scratch test.
Non-blocking confirmed: both directions returned 0 from gate_in; the STALE run's WARN appeared on the same stream but did not alter control flow.

Timing: isolated check-deploy-freshness.sh invocation against this repo's 6-extension .claude-extensions.json averaged ~131ms across 3 runs (~22ms/extension) -- higher than the Phase 1 research's raw 0.002-0.004s-per-git-log estimate because each extension entry costs 3 jq subprocess forks plus 2 git subprocess forks, not git alone. Full gate_in-in-a-subshell timing (includes task-lock acquire/release overhead) averaged ~488ms with the checker present vs. ~433ms with it hidden, a ~55ms delta consistent with the isolated measurement once subshell/lock noise is accounted for.
